subject: Coord: Skyline Systems x Redwood — co-sell demo slot and runbook
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@skyline-systems.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-10T08:22:00-04:00
Subject: Skyline co-sell demo — proposed slots and runbook

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the interest in a joint demo with Skyline + Redwood + AWS Marketplace. To keep the session tight for your execs, proposed options below (CEST times):

- Tue Sep 14 — 11:00 CEST (preferred)
- Tue Sep 14 — 16:00 CEST (backup, longer overlap for APAC)

Agenda (30–45 min): 1) short intro (Redwood + Skyline), 2) demo flow (Skyline shows integration; Redwood covers performance and marketplace listing), 3) Q&A and next steps.

I attached a short runbook with presenter notes and a proposed slide order — please flag any changes. Can you confirm: preferred slot, attendee list, and if we should include an AWS Marketplace rep on the call?

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: skyline-demo-runbook-v1.pdf
From: Elena Rossi <elena@skyline-systems.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-11T10:05:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Skyline co-sell demo — proposed slots and runbook

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the options and the runbook — looks good. Our core stakeholders prefer Tue Sep 14 at 11:00 CEST. Attendees: Elena Rossi (PM), Martin Vogel (CTO), Ana Pereira (Head of Cloud Partnerships).

Please loop in: Carlos Mendes from our SI (sysintegrate.io) — he will drive the technical integration portion — and an AWS Marketplace contact so we can discuss listing requirements.

Elena

Head of Product, Skyline Systems

Elena / Soojin —

Quick heads up from the SI coordination side: Carlos flagged a conflict at 11:00 CEST — his team can make 11:30 CEST but not 11:00. If Carlos doing the integration demo is necessary, can we either:

- shift to 11:30 CEST (shorten intro to keep 45 min total), or
- keep 11:00 CEST and have Carlos join the last 20 minutes for the deep-dive (he can dial in from 11:20).

Either works for us; wanted to surface the constraint so we have a decision before we send invites.

Karthik

Hi all —

Apologies, tight week on our side. I can make the session on Tue the 14th but only at 11:30 CEST. I can do a 45-minute slot starting 11:30 (we'll keep the technical deep-dive focused to the last 20). Action items for me: share the integration checklist and a short config snippet.

If 11:30 breaks any stakeholder schedules, I can instead join at 11:20 live for the deeper portion.

Carlos Mendes
Senior Solutions Architect, SysIntegrate

Subject: Final confirmation — Sep 14 11:30 CEST (Skyline x Redwood x SysIntegrate + AWS)

Thanks everyone —

We’ll run the demo Tue Sep 14 at 11:30 CEST (10:30 BST). Final run order (45 min):

1) 11:30 — 11:35 : quick intros (Soojin / Elena)
2) 11:35 — 11:50 : Skyline integration walkthrough (Elena + Carlos)
3) 11:50 — 12:05 : Redwood performance & marketplace listing overview (Karthik)
4) 12:05 — 12:15 : Q&A and next steps

Attachments: skyline-demo-runbook-v1.pdf (updated minor notes); calendar invite attached: skyline-demo-invite.ics. Shared folder with collateral: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SkylineRunbook

Requests:
- AWS Marketplace team — please join at 11:50 if possible to confirm listing checklist items and timelines.
- Carlos — please upload the integration checklist to the shared folder before the call if you can.

I'll send the calendar invite now. See you on Tue.

Best,
